data.name: Recall
data.description: With a touch, you can cause a creature to recall some bit of forgotten lore or information. The creature can retry any Knowledge skill check it has made within the past minute, gaining a +%1 insight bonus on the check. You can use this ability %2 times per day|WIS|DomainKnowledgeTimes
